messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] silverpine-prod (dedicated VPC pool) — tenant=SilverpineCorp — GPU utilization 98%, avg queue length 11. Paging @erin_oncall. metrics: https://redwood.internal/metrics/1769123456

erin_oncall: ack — I'm on it. grabbing queue logs and pool config. pinging infra/runtime. ETA 5m

maya_support: CS got a call from Silverpine — they see increased 429s and slow completions since 09:12 UTC. Customer on the line :phone:

james_infra: infra data: 3 nodes hitting 99% mem, queue per GPU jumped 3 -> 12. Autoscaler didn't open new nodes because tenant reserve was set equal to pool limit (reserve=10, limit=10). `redwoodctl pools describe silverpine-prod` shows no burst enabled.

lina_runtime: idea: we have a q4_0 quantized build of their main model ready. Switching would reduce memory per replica ~30% and lower queueing. Can do staged rollout with minimal disruption.

erin_oncall: options we can take now: 1) emergency burst from shared spare (needs CS approval) 2) force-route to quantized variant (lina can run) 3) apply soft rate-limit to reduce arriving load (support coordinate). Which should we prioritize?

sam_cs: on call with customer now. Contract permits temporary emergency burst for P1 incidents with notification. Customer verbally approves immediate burst to stabilize. :white_check_mark:

alex_pager: I can run the burst allocation once CS confirms. Running command now if we have inventory.

alex_pager: ``
redwoodctl pools burst-allocate --pool silverpine-prod --add 8 --reason \"P1 tenant GPU pressure\"
``

incident-bot: Burst request queued, checking spare inventory...

james_infra: spare pool inventory: 12 available GPUs. Proceeding to allocate 8 to silverpine-prod.

incident-bot: Burst successful. New pool capacity: 18 GPUs (was 10). Event recorded -> INC-1769123456-burst-alloc

erin_oncall: good. Lina, please start the quantized canary to reduce sustained pressure. We'll keep the burst active while we validate.

lina_runtime: starting 10% canary to q4_0 now: `route update --pool silverpine-prod --matrix \"q4_0:10%\"`

lina_runtime: canary looks clean (latency ok, no errors). progressing to 50%.

maya_support: Silverpine reporting improvement — 429s dropping, p95 latency reducing. Customer says traffic feels back to normal :relieved:

erin_oncall: metrics: queue length down to ~2 per GPU, utilization ~70%. Marking as mitigated for now. Follow-ups: - raise tenant reserve or set non-zero max_burst - add explicit burst-approval runbook steps - inform billing re: emergency burst usage

alex_pager: noted. Holding burst allocation until midnight PST per on-call plan, unless further issues. I'll file ticket BILL-1769123456 for tracking.

sam_cs: I'll send official incident note to Silverpine summarizing actions and confirm billing adjustments are acceptable.

erin_oncall: thanks team. Closing this active paging at 1769123610 as mitigated. If SLA error delta >1% we'll open a postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident state: P1 -> mitigated. Timeline and logs: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1769123456
